notes.title: Mythrealm Demo - Hotfix - Version 1.12
notes.content:
Greetings adventurers into the Mythrealm! 


Mythrealm Game Demo Version 1.12 is now live on Steam!   



This is a Hotfix that includes a major fix for the Start Screen bug. We apologise for the inconvenience this bug caused to some users. 

 

-- Mythrealm Game Demo V1.12 - Change List --  



The game will no longer crash / close after Pressing Any Key to Start and the screen fading to black.

The Arcane 2 Spell: Mage Shield should no longer block the players arrows. 

  

We will continue to work on fixing any bugs we find or players report. Thanks for playing Mythrealm!   

Happy adventuring! :-)

notes.title: Mythrealm Demo - Hotfix - Version 1.11
notes.content:
Greetings adventurers into the Mythrealm! 


Mythrealm Game Demo Version 1.11 is now live on Steam!  


This is a Hotfix that includes a few  bug fixes.  


-- Mythrealm Game Demo V1.11 - Change List --  



The Tumble (Dodge Roll) Keyboard Binding can now be remapped in the Settings.

The Fairy NPC Vendor in Level 01 can now be interacted with using a Gamepad / Controller. 

A "Click the Text to Continue..." message has been added to Vendor Dialogue to make it more clear how to proceed in the conversation with the NPC. 

A bugged rock in the level 01 climbing shaft has been fixed. 
 

We will continue to work on fixing any bugs we find or players report. Thanks for playing Mythrealm!   

Happy adventuring! :-)

notes.title: indie.io - Official Publisher Announcement!
notes.content:
Hey there! We at Delta Video Games have some fantastic news for you! 

We are delighted to announce that Delta Video Games [DVG] has forged a publishing partnership with the excellent indie video games publisher Indie.Io! From today onwards indie.io is the official publisher of Mythrealm and DVG's other sci-fi shooter game Assault On Proxima. 

This is really great news for Mythrealm, and we also hope, for the players! 

To learn more about indie.io and check out their wonderful library of games visit their publisher page on Steam:  

 indie.io's Steam Publisher Page. 

For those of you who may not know, working with a game publishing platform like indie.io greatly helps indie developers focus on game development while they handle all the behind-the-scenes magic. From helping manage store pages to crafting marketing campaigns and even helping the game shine at both digital and live events, indie.io helps in all the aspects that indie developers often struggle with alone. 

Delta Video Games is super happy to be working with indie.io as it will allow our small team to focus on what we do best - making our best games! 

We chose indie.io as the publisher ( And they chose us too! Thanks indie.io! ) of our games for a few core reasons: 

 We really admire indie.io's range of fun and cool indie games that include a mix of casual and serious games in a variety of genres from fantasy, to sci-fi, to post apocalyptic and more! We hope our games Mythrealm and Assault On Proxima will fit right into their amazing portfolio and reach gamers who love those styles! 

 indie.io gives us the creative freedom we need to follow our vision and make the games we believe in. They don't tell us what to make, they just help us make our games the best they can be and help our games reach a wider audience!  

 Perhaps a little known fact but indie.io also runs the Wiki Website, Wiki.GG! We're also partnering with Wiki.GG. to bring you the Mythrealm Wiki. If you like reading about games, check out Wiki.GG - it may have a page for your favourite game! 
 

 Check out The Mythrealm Wiki! 

 Check out Wiki.GG! 

Striving forward into a mystical future it's gonna be great fun to partner with indie.io in bringing our games to you, the player. Over all it's a great advent for our small studio to work with such a cool publisher and it's really going to help us grow as a developer and bring you amazing and authentic games!  

Don’t forget to Wishlist Mythrealm, join our Discord community and follow us on social media to be notified of future announcements!  

Thanks for reading.  See you and our friends at indie.io in the Mythrealm! 

Happy Gaming and follow your dreams! 
Delta Video Games.
